name: uiless-screen-recorder
description: Headless, script-controlled screen recorder with a source-separated, voice-isolation-ready audio pipeline. No UI.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/global.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/screen-recorder.global.js
